title: CV Tutorial chapters 16–20 — claim/source register
scope: Primary papers and official APIs; figures, pointer examples and runnable samples are illustrative, not benchmarks.

entries.claim: R-CNN replaces hand-crafted features with CNN features on bottom-up region proposals and reaches 53.3% mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012, a >30% relative gain over the previous best
entries.caveat: Figure taken from the paper abstract; VOC 2007 numbers and per-backbone comparisons live in the paper tables and are not restated here

entries.claim: Box regression targets are t_x=(G_x-P_x)/P_w, t_y=(G_y-P_y)/P_h, t_w=log(G_w/P_w), t_h=log(G_h/P_h) with Smooth L1 loss
entries.caveat: MathML states the four targets and the inverse decode; P_w,P_h>0 required

entries.claim: Selective Search oversegments, greedily merges regions by color/texture/size/shape and needs no training data
entries.caveat: The ~2000-box budget and recall percentage are paper-specific and not reproduced numerically here

entries.claim: Faster R-CNN shares the backbone with RPN; default anchors are 3 scales (128^2,256^2,512^2) x 3 ratios (1:1,1:2,2:1) = 9 per location
entries.caveat: Scale set and k are implementation choices; only the default config is stated, and other rows in the anchor table are labelled as adjustments

entries.claim: RPN labels anchors positive at IoU>0.7 (or best match), negative at IoU<0.3, ignores the rest; loss = cls + lambda*reg with reg masked by p*
entries.caveat: MathML shows the two-term multi-task loss; N_cls/N_reg normalisation constants and lambda value come from the paper's default setup

entries.claim: The paper alternates RPN and Fast R-CNN training; modern frameworks use approximate joint training
entries.caveat: RoIAlign comes from Mask R-CNN (2017), not from the 2015 faster R-CNN paper; numeric AP gains are not fixed here

entries.claim: YOLOv1 divides the image into SxS (7x7) cells, each predicting B boxes and C class probabilities, output tensor SxSx(B*5+C)=7x7x30 on VOC; confidence = Pr(Object)*IoU
entries.caveat: 45 FPS / 155 FPS figures are the paper's Titan X numbers and are hardware dependent

entries.claim: SSD detects on six feature maps (38^2..1^2) with default boxes, uses hard negative mining ~1:3; SSD300 reports 74.3% VOC2007 mAP vs YOLOv1 63.4%
entries.caveat: Both are the papers' reported VOC 2007 numbers; speed parity depends on implementation and hardware

entries.claim: Focal Loss is FL(p_t) = -alpha_t (1-p_t)^gamma log(p_t), down-weighting easy examples to counter foreground/background imbalance
entries.caveat: The MathML states the loss form; gamma and alpha defaults come from the RetinaNet paper

entries.claim: DETR predicts a set of N (100) objects with object queries and uses Hungarian matching, removing NMS and anchors
entries.caveat: Deformable DETR is a distinct follow-up; convergence/speed remarks are qualitative, not fixed numbers

entries.claim: Semantic segmentation assigns a class per pixel but not instance ids; instance segmentation separates countable things; panoptic segmentation unifies things+stuff over all pixels
entries.caveat: Task outputs and metrics differ; mask AP (COCO) and mIoU (Cityscapes) are not interchangeable

entries.claim: mask IoU = |P∩G|/|P∪G|; mIoU averages per-class IoU; Dice = 2|P∩G|/(|P|+|G|) = 2*IoU/(1+IoU)
entries.caveat: Whether background counts and whether to ignore absent classes are conventions that change reported mIoU

entries.claim: Dataset lineage and scale: VOC2012, COCO, Cityscapes (5000 fine + 20000 coarse, 19 eval classes), ADE20K, BDD100K
entries.caveat: Sizes are stated as approximate orders of magnitude and must be checked against official pages

entries.claim: U-Net is a symmetric encoder-decoder with contracting channels 64-128-256-512-1024, 2x3x3 conv + ReLU + 2x2 max-pool, transposed-conv upsampling and feature concatenation from the encoder
entries.caveat: Original uses valid (unpadded) convolutions so 572x572 input yields 388x388 output with cropping; the runnable snippet assumes this valid-conv topology, while many modern reimplementations use same-padding
d1,d2 are distances to nearest and second-nearest cell borders; w_0 and sigma are paper hyperparameters not restated numerically

entries.claim: Variants include 3D U-Net, Attention U-Net, U-Net++ and nnU-Net (an auto-configuration framework, not a new architecture)
entries.caveat: Citation counts are not fixed here; overlap-tile and elastic deformation are from the original paper
